title: ornithoxanthum luteum
intro: Ornithoxanthum luteum, commonly known as Yellow Bird's Eye, is a flowering plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to exhibit health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ornithoxanthum luteum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antifungal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of Ornithoxanthum luteum.
